records.name: August Fehlstart
records.biography_en: Fehlstart supplies the HyperNorm entrance with a squeeze horn and the optimism necessary to try it again. A card allowing a mistake to remain useful opens his enormous crooked laugh: an audience is either delighted or not yet ready. Hunky & Dory request dependable morale. He squeezes the bulb, hoping the next unexpected sound will turn out to have been intentional.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Auftakt ist erfolgt. Seine Übereinstimmung mit dem Plan wird nachträglich angenommen.

variant_notes.note_en: He hears the first laugh as confirmation that the plan must have started successfully.

records.name: Madame Punktgenau
records.biography_en: Punktgenau balances a red ball in the HyperNorm rehearsal corner while holding the baton below an already disapproving lip. A card suggesting that delight can arrive without permission receives her narrowest glance: a performance is either precise or an interruption. Men in Black appreciate discipline. She waits for the room to become sufficiently silent to deserve the joke.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Heiterkeit ist zugelassen. Ihr Eintritt bedarf noch des richtigen Augenblicks.

variant_notes.note_en: She will permit spontaneous amusement as soon as its timing has been approved.

records.name: Pierrot Vielleicht
records.biography_en: Vielleicht keeps a drooping flower upright in the HyperNorm waiting area with both hands and very little certainty. A card allowing sorrow and affection to occupy the same gesture deepens his lower lip: a feeling is either sincere or badly performed. Hunky & Dory request a brighter atmosphere. He adjusts the stem, giving hope another modest chance to bend.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Hoffnung wurde mitgebracht. Ihre Haltung bleibt vorläufig nachgiebig.

variant_notes.note_en: He has brought a small hopeful gesture and is trying not to place unreasonable demands on it.

records.name: Colombina Nebenwitz
records.biography_en: Nebenwitz attends the HyperNorm reception with a fan at her belly and a little mask hanging well away from her uncovered eyes. A card allowing discretion to include candour earns a nearly closed grin: a hint is either understood or delightfully deniable. Men in Black request appropriate amusement. She glances upward, letting the listener supply the part nobody has quite said.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Andeutung ist vollständig. Der ausgesprochene Teil wurde dem Publikum überlassen.

variant_notes.note_en: She lets the audience finish the dangerous half of the joke and keeps the fan below her actual expression.

records.name: Harlekin Umspiel
records.biography_en: Umspiel waits beside the HyperNorm stage door with two wooden blades joined at a handle and an expression that has already gone around the corner. A card allowing play to follow a rule without obeying its purpose tightens his smile: an obstacle is either passed or reintroduced as a joke. Hunky & Dory request a predictable entrance. He leaves a small pause where the certainty should have been.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Der Ablauf wurde eingehalten. Seine Reihenfolge behauptet weiterhin Eigenständigkeit.

variant_notes.note_en: He regards an obstruction as a useful place to insert the next beat.

records.name: Hofnarr Wahrmund
records.biography_en: Wahrmund carries a smiling wooden marotte into the HyperNorm audience chamber and keeps his own mouth considerably less settled. A card allowing criticism to remain loyal sends his eyes upward: a truth is either a punchline or poorly timed. Men in Black permit appropriate ridicule. He gives the rattle the first turn, hoping authority may find a carved smile easier to hear.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: Die Bemerkung war zulässig. Der Holzkollege übernimmt vorsorglich den Wortlaut.

variant_notes.note_en: He tests whether the truth is safer when the wooden version of himself appears to have said it.
